notes: Source page mismatch: the catalog text is for 'Business (Applied), Associate of Science Degree' (Banner Code 3_AS_BSCBE, Control Number 46623, a Pace+ program), not the Supervision A.A. Degree. No section for Supervision appears in the text, so no blocks, total, outcomes or careers were recorded for this award.

The Business (Applied) A.S. section lists 21 required courses totaling 60 units (including general education courses such as ENGL C1000, COMM C1000, KIN C101, MATH C101), four program learning outcomes, and potential careers (Administrative Services Managers, Facilities Managers, General and Operations Managers, Human Resources Assistants); these were not attributed to Supervision.
A reviewer should locate the correct Coastline catalog page for the Supervision A.A. Degree.
